name: av_inflation
description:
Annual US inflation rate (consumer prices, percent) from Alpha Vantage (INFLATION). Takes no inputs.
Returns: {name, interval, unit, data: [{date, value}]} with yearly values as strings, newest first.
For the monthly index level use av_cpi; other sources: fred_cpi, openbb_economy_cpi.
Example: {}
